title: Tyres — DPP characteristics
description: Field specifications for the Tyres Digital Product Passport, shaped for UNTP's credentialSubject.characteristics extension point. Economic operators and facility identifiers are carried by the UNTP envelope and are deliberately absent here.

commercialName.title: Commercial Name
commercialName.description: Commercial product name or trade designation
commercialName.x-provision: Annex II (product information sheet — commercial name/trade designation)

tyreTypeIdentifier.title: Tyre Type Identifier
tyreTypeIdentifier.description: Tyre type identifier as registered in EPREL
tyreTypeIdentifier.x-provision: Art. 4 + Annex II (tyre type identifier registered in EPREL)

tyreClass.title: Tyre Class
tyreClass.description: Tyre class: C1 (passenger car), C2 (light truck/van), C3 (heavy truck/bus)

batchLotNumber.title: Batch or Serial Number
batchLotNumber.description: Production batch code (DOT code includes week/year of manufacture)

dateOfManufactureWeekYear.title: Date of Manufacture (Week/Year)
dateOfManufactureWeekYear.description: Week and year of manufacture (last 4 digits of DOT code: WWYY)
dateOfManufactureWeekYear.x-provision: Annex II (product information sheet) + UNECE R30/R54 date-of-manufacture marking

dateStartOfProduction.title: Date Start of Production
dateStartOfProduction.description: Date when production of this tyre type started (Week/Year)

dateEndOfProduction.title: Date End of Production
dateEndOfProduction.description: Date when production of this tyre type ended (Week/Year), if applicable

eprelRegistrationNumber.title: EPREL Registration Number
eprelRegistrationNumber.description: Registration number in the EU EPREL database
eprelRegistrationNumber.x-provision: Art. 4(2) + Art. 10 (registration in EPREL before placing on market)

eprelProductUrl.title: EPREL Product URL
eprelProductUrl.description: Direct URL to the product entry in EPREL

dataCarrierType.title: Data Carrier Type
dataCarrierType.description: Type of data carrier linking to the DPP (QR code, RFID, etc.)

passportIssuer.title: Passport Issuer
passportIssuer.description: Entity responsible for creating and updating the DPP

tyreSizeDesignation.title: Tyre Size Designation
tyreSizeDesignation.description: Standard tyre size designation (width/aspect ratio + construction + rim diameter)
tyreSizeDesignation.x-provision: Annex II (product information sheet — tyre size designation)

loadCapacityIndex.title: Load Capacity Index
loadCapacityIndex.description: Load index number indicating maximum load-bearing capacity
loadCapacityIndex.x-provision: Annex II (product information sheet — load-capacity index)

loadVersion.title: Load Version
loadVersion.description: Load version designation (Standard Load / Extra Load / Reinforced)

speedCategorySymbol.title: Speed Category Symbol
speedCategorySymbol.description: Speed rating symbol indicating maximum speed capability
speedCategorySymbol.x-provision: Annex II (product information sheet — speed category symbol)

speedRatingKmh.title: Speed Rating (km/h)
speedRatingKmh.description: Maximum speed in km/h corresponding to speed category symbol

aspectRatio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio (sidewall height as percentage of section width)

treadDepthMm.title: Tread Depth (mm)
treadDepthMm.description: New tyre tread depth in millimetres

tyreWeightKg.title: Tyre Weight (kg)
tyreWeightKg.description: Weight of a single new tyre in kilograms

fuelEfficiencyClass.title: Fuel Efficiency Class
fuelEfficiencyClass.description: Rolling resistance / fuel efficiency class (A to E scale, A = best)
fuelEfficiencyClass.x-provision: Art. 4 + Annex I Part A (fuel-efficiency/rolling-resistance class)

rollingResistanceCoefficientNKn.title: Rolling Resistance Coefficient (N/kN)
rollingResistanceCoefficientNKn.description: Rolling Resistance Coefficient (RRC) in N/kN, measured per UNECE Reg. 117
rollingResistanceCoefficientNKn.x-provision: Annex I Part A + Annex II; measured per UNECE R117 Annex 6

wetGripClass.title: Wet Grip Class
wetGripClass.description: Wet grip braking performance class (A to E scale, A = best)
wetGripClass.x-provision: Art. 4 + Annex I Part B (wet-grip class)

externalRollingNoiseClass.title: External Rolling Noise Class
externalRollingNoiseClass.description: External rolling noise class (A, B, or C)
externalRollingNoiseClass.x-provision: Art. 4 + Annex I Part C (external rolling-noise class)

externalRollingNoiseDb.title: External Rolling Noise (dB)
externalRollingNoiseDb.description: External rolling noise measured value in dB(A), rounded to nearest integer
externalRollingNoiseDb.x-provision: Annex I Part C + Annex II (measured dB value); measured per UNECE R117 Annex 3

snowGrip.title: Snow Grip
snowGrip.description: Whether tyre has 3PMSF (3 Peak Mountain Snow Flake) certification for severe snow conditions
snowGrip.x-provision: Art. 4 + Annex I (3PMSF snow-grip pictogram where applicable)

iceGrip.title: Ice Grip
iceGrip.description: Whether tyre is certified for ice grip performance (Nordic ice conditions)
iceGrip.x-provision: Art. 4 + Annex I (ice-grip marking, C1 tyres, per ISO 19447)

tyreAbrasionRateMgKm.title: Tyre Abrasion Rate (mg/km)
tyreAbrasionRateMgKm.description: Tyre abrasion rate in mg/km (mass loss per km driven), per Euro 7 methodology

abrasionIndex.title: Abrasion Index
abrasionIndex.description: Abrasion index relative to reference tyre (ratio of candidate/reference abrasion)

abrasionTestMethod.title: Abrasion Test Method
abrasionTestMethod.description: Test method used: 'convoy_on_road' or 'laboratory_drum' per UNECE TFTA

testDistanceKm.title: Test Distance (km)
testDistanceKm.description: Total distance driven during abrasion test (typically ~8000 km for convoy method)

microplasticsEmissionClass.title: Microplastics Emission Class
microplasticsEmissionClass.description: Microplastics emission class (classification TBD, expected in Euro 7 implementing acts)

mileageWarrantyKm.title: Mileage Warranty (km)
mileageWarrantyKm.description: Manufacturer mileage/tread wear warranty in kilometres (if offered)

billOfMaterials.title: Bill of Materials
billOfMaterials.description: Structured list of tyre materials by weight percentage

totalTyreWeightKg.title: Total Tyre Weight (kg)
totalTyreWeightKg.description: Total weight of the finished tyre

naturalRubberContentPercentage.title: Natural Rubber Content (%)
naturalRubberContentPercentage.description: Percentage of natural rubber (NR) by weight

syntheticRubberContentPercentage.title: Synthetic Rubber Content (%)
syntheticRubberContentPercentage.description: Percentage of synthetic rubber (SBR, BR, etc.) by weight

recycledContentPercentage.title: Recycled Content (%)
recycledContentPercentage.description: Percentage of recycled materials in the tyre by weight

recycledCarbonBlackPercentage.title: Recycled Carbon Black (%)
recycledCarbonBlackPercentage.description: Percentage of recovered carbon black (rCB) from end-of-life tyres

renewableMaterialContentPercentage.title: Renewable Material Content (%)
renewableMaterialContentPercentage.description: Percentage of bio-based or renewable materials (e.g. natural rubber, bio-based oils)

pahContentCompliant.title: PAH Content Compliant
pahContentCompliant.description: Confirmation that extender oils comply with PAH (polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon) limits per REACH Annex XVII Entry 50
pahContentCompliant.x-provision: Annex XVII Entry 50 (PAH limits in extender oils/tyres)

svhcCandidateListSubstances.title: SVHC Candidate List Substances
svhcCandidateListSubstances.description: Substances of Very High Concern present above 0.1% w/w threshold
svhcCandidateListSubstances.x-provision: Art. 33 (SVHC in articles >0.1% w/w communication) + SCIP database notification

sixPpdContent.title: 6PPD Content
sixPpdContent.description: Presence and concentration of 6PPD antioxidant (under ECHA review for environmental toxicity of 6PPD-quinone)

heavyMetalsCompliance.title: Heavy Metals Compliance
heavyMetalsCompliance.description: Confirmation of compliance with heavy metal limits (lead, cadmium, mercury, chromium VI)

carbonFootprint.title: Carbon Footprint (kg CO2e)
carbonFootprint.description: Total product carbon footprint in kg CO2-equivalent (cradle-to-gate)

carbonFootprintMethodology.title: Carbon Footprint Methodology
carbonFootprintMethodology.description: Methodology used for carbon footprint calculation

fuelSavingsOverLifetimeLiters.title: Fuel Savings Over Lifetime (liters)
fuelSavingsOverLifetimeLiters.description: Estimated fuel savings over tyre lifetime vs. reference E-class tyre (liters)

co2SavingsOverLifetimeKg.title: CO2 Savings Over Lifetime (kg)
co2SavingsOverLifetimeKg.description: Estimated CO2 savings over tyre lifetime vs. reference E-class tyre (kg)

naturalRubberDeforestationFree.title: Natural Rubber Deforestation-Free
naturalRubberDeforestationFree.description: Declaration that natural rubber sourcing is deforestation-free
naturalRubberDeforestationFree.x-provision: Art. 3 + Art. 4 (due-diligence statement) + Annex I (natural rubber covered)

naturalRubberSustainabilityCertification.title: Natural Rubber Sustainability Certification
naturalRubberSustainabilityCertification.description: Sustainability certification for natural rubber (GPSNR, FSC, PEFC, SNR-i, etc.)

expectedMileageKm.title: Expected Mileage (km)
expectedMileageKm.description: Expected tyre lifespan in kilometres under normal use

treadwearRating.title: Treadwear Rating
treadwearRating.description: UTQG Treadwear rating (if applicable, primarily US but widely published)

minimumTreadDepthMm.title: Minimum Tread Depth (mm)
minimumTreadDepthMm.description: Legal minimum tread depth before replacement (EU standard: 1.6mm)

maxAgeRecommendationYears.title: Max Age Recommendation (years)
maxAgeRecommendationYears.description: Recommended maximum tyre age regardless of tread depth

retreadable.title: Retreadable
retreadable.description: Whether the tyre casing is designed and approved for retreading

maximumRetreadCycles.title: Maximum Retread Cycles
maximumRetreadCycles.description: Maximum number of retread cycles the casing supports

retreadServiceLifeExtensionKm.title: Retread Service Life Extension (km)
retreadServiceLifeExtensionKm.description: Additional service life per retread cycle in km (for retreadable tyres: ~220,000 km per cycle for truck tyres)

recyclabilityPercentage.title: Recyclability (%)
recyclabilityPercentage.description: Percentage of tyre weight recoverable through material recycling or energy recovery

disassemblyInstructionsUrl.title: Disassembly Instructions URL
disassemblyInstructionsUrl.description: URL to end-of-life processing instructions for recyclers

pyrolysisSuitability.title: Pyrolysis Suitability
pyrolysisSuitability.description: Whether the tyre is suitable for pyrolysis recycling

devulcanizationSuitability.title: Devulcanization Suitability
devulcanizationSuitability.description: Whether the rubber compound is suitable for devulcanization recycling

euro7Compliance.title: Euro 7 Compliance
euro7Compliance.description: Compliance status with Euro 7 tyre abrasion limits

euTyreLabelImageUrl.title: EU Tyre Label Image URL
euTyreLabelImageUrl.description: URL to the official EU tyre label image

declarationOfConformityUrl.title: Declaration of Conformity URL
declarationOfConformityUrl.description: URL to EU Declaration of Conformity

recommendedInflationPressureKpa.title: Recommended Inflation Pressure (kPa)
recommendedInflationPressureKpa.description: Recommended cold inflation pressure in kPa

maximumInflationPressureKpa.title: Maximum Inflation Pressure (kPa)
maximumInflationPressureKpa.description: Maximum permissible inflation pressure in kPa

maximumLoadKg.title: Maximum Load (kg)
maximumLoadKg.description: Maximum load per tyre in kg (corresponding to load index)

tyrePressureMonitoringCompatible.title: TPMS Compatible
tyrePressureMonitoringCompatible.description: Compatibility with TPMS (Tyre Pressure Monitoring Systems)

runFlatCapability.title: Run-Flat Capability
runFlatCapability.description: Whether the tyre has run-flat technology

safetyWarnings.title: Safety Warnings
safetyWarnings.x-provision: GPSR Art. 9 (safety information/warnings & instructions to accompany the product)

storageInstructions.title: Storage Instructions
storageInstructions.description: Recommended storage conditions for unused tyres

dppSchemaVersion.title: DPP Schema Version
dppSchemaVersion.description: Version of the DPP schema used
